notablePrerequisites:
Scaretiller is untapped.
You have a basic Mountain, Forest or Plains in library.
description:
Play Cabaretti Courtyard.
Cabaretti Courtyard enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping any land you control.
Resolve the Cabaretti Courtyard trigger, causing you to sacrifice it, then search your library for a basic Forest, Plains or Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, and gain 1 life.
The basic land enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scaretiller.
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {G}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Cabaretti Courtyard from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.
